name: Erumani
source:
People from different worlds and races are summoned to a certain world, and now they are searching for a way back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
來自不同世界、不同種族的人們被召喚到某個世界，如今正尋找返回故鄉的方法。

[來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
